_about: Rules that write the public note for an intervention's impact, and the fixed text of the impact panels. For each note kind (`waterbody`, `unit` for desilting; `fp_waterbody`, `fp_unit`, `fp_old`, `fp_none` for new ponds and tanks, older structures and waterbodies that cannot be assessed) the first rule whose `when` holds gives the main sentence; every `add` rule whose `when` holds appends its sentence. Placeholders in braces are filled from the record (seft/impact/notes.py lists them). Expressions use the same syntax as the other knowledge files. `panel` and `fp_panel` hold the labels, headings and explanations around the notes in the atlas panels; its placeholders are listed in `panel._placeholders`.

main.text: The effect of {intervention_label_lower} in {year_label} cannot be assessed yet: {reason}.

After {intervention_label_lower} in {year_label}, this {type_label} held water about {effect_abs} weeks longer than {n_controls} similar untreated waterbodies within {radius_km} km in {post_text}, the only year of data after the work so far. That is an early sign of a gain; another year of data is needed to confirm it.

After {intervention_label_lower} in {year_label}, this {type_label} held water about {effect_abs} weeks less than {n_controls} similar untreated waterbodies within {radius_km} km in {post_text}, the only year of data after the work so far. That is an early sign of a loss; another year of data is needed to confirm it.

After {intervention_label_lower} in {year_label}, this {type_label} held water about {effect_abs} weeks a year longer than {n_controls} similar untreated waterbodies within {radius_km} km, over {post_text}. Untreated waterbodies show a gain this large less than one time in ten, so the gain is likely real.

After {intervention_label_lower} in {year_label}, this {type_label} held water about {effect_abs} weeks a year less than {n_controls} similar untreated waterbodies within {radius_km} km, over {post_text}. A loss this large is unusual; ask whether the work changed the inlet, the outlet or the bund.

After {intervention_label_lower} in {year_label}, this {type_label} held water {effect_signed} weeks a year compared with {n_controls} similar untreated waterbodies within {radius_km} km, but {reason}, so the result is unsettled.

After {intervention_label_lower} in {year_label}, this {type_label} held water {effect_signed} weeks a year compared with {n_controls} similar untreated waterbodies within {radius_km} km, over {post_text}. That is within the range untreated waterbodies show by chance, so no change can be told apart. A change smaller than one season may not show in seasonal data.

panel._about: Fixed text of the impact panels in the waterbody atlas (web/index.html, impT). Text is shown as written; placeholders in braces are filled by the page.

_placeholders.unit_summary: n, lo, hi, did_rain, counterfactual, prepost_rain, reference_mean

panel.placebo_row: Placebo: pretend the work was in {year}
panel.controls: Controls: {n} untreated {type_plural} within {radius_km} km, chosen from {candidates} candidates, outside this waterbody's micro-watershed, matched on size, catchment, stream order, rainfall, drought and the water held in each year before the work (median match distance {median_distance}).
panel.reference: The percentile compares the headline estimate with {n} untreated waterbodies of {scope} in this district, run through the same steps as if treated.
panel.waterbody_footer: Estimated by comparing this waterbody's change with the change at similar untreated waterbodies nearby over the same years (Methodology tab). Each result is placed among untreated waterbodies run through the same steps, so chance changes are not read as effects.
panel.unit_summary: Average of the headline estimate over {n} assessed works without record-quality flags (95% range {lo} to {hi} weeks a year). Other estimators: rainfall-matched {did_rain}, counterfactual model {counterfactual}, post minus pre without controls {prepost_rain} weeks. Untreated waterbodies run through the same steps average {reference_mean}.
panel.chart_aria: Weeks of water, this waterbody and its controls
panel.chart_formula: Weeks of water a year = 17.3 × (kharif + rabi + summer shares) / 100.

main.text: This {type_label} first held water in {year_label}, so it is treated as a new pond, but its effect on cropping around it cannot be assessed: {reason}.

This {type_label} first held water in {year_label}. In {post_text}, cropping intensity in its zone of influence was about {effect_abs} points higher than predicted had it not been built. That is an early sign of a gain: it rests on too few years, or on years in which nearly every pond of the district had already been built, to confirm.

This {type_label} first held water in {year_label}. In {post_text}, cropping intensity in its zone of influence was about {effect_abs} points lower than predicted had it not been built. That is an early sign of a loss: it rests on too few years, or on years in which nearly every pond of the district had already been built, to confirm.

This {type_label} first held water in {year_label}. Over {post_text}, cropping intensity in its zone of influence was about {effect_abs} points a year higher than predicted had it not been built. Ponds show a difference this large in the years before they were built less than one time in ten, so the gain is likely real.

This {type_label} first held water in {year_label}. Over {post_text}, cropping intensity in its zone of influence was about {effect_abs} points a year lower than predicted had it not been built. A loss this large is unusual; ask whether the pond took more cropland than its own area, or whether the zone of influence is drawn around the wrong fields.

This {type_label} first held water in {year_label}. Over {post_text}, cropping intensity in its zone of influence differed by {effect_signed} points from the prediction had it not been built, but {reason}, so the result is unsettled.

This {type_label} first held water in {year_label}. Over {post_text}, cropping intensity in its zone of influence differed by {effect_signed} points from the prediction had it not been built. That is within the range ponds show in the years before they were built, so no change can be told apart from year-to-year variation.

fp_panel.waterbody_eyebrow: Impact of a new pond or tank
fp_panel.row_placebo: Placebo: the year before it first held water
fp_panel.row_percentile: Percentile among ponds in the years before they were built
fp_panel.lining_detail: Water after it first filled: summer water in {summer_years}% of years, over {summer_area}% of its area on average; rabi water {rabi}%, kharif {kharif}%; fill in drought ÷ normal years {fill_ratio}.
fp_panel.method_note: The prediction comes from the pond's own years before it was built, ponds in {district} district not yet built in the same year, the cropping of its micro-watershed (leaving out the fields around other new ponds) and kharif drought weeks. Outcomes after construction are corrected for the cropland the pond itself occupies.
fp_panel.flag_appeared_2019: first wet in 2019-20 after the dry years 2017-18, so it may be an older pond
fp_panel.flag_small: under 0.1 ha, where the water classifier is least reliable
fp_panel.chart_aria: Cropping intensity in the zone of influence, its micro-watershed and the prediction without the pond
fp_panel.waterbody_footer: New ponds are found from the water series: there is no registry. The effect is observed cropping minus the prediction had the pond not been built, and it is placed among the same differences for ponds in the years before they were built, so that chance changes are not read as effects (Impact assessment tab).
fp_panel.unit_eyebrow: Impact of new ponds and tanks
fp_panel.unit_summary: Average over {n} assessed ponds (95% range {lo} to {hi} points of cropping intensity). By how their water looks: lined {lined}, uncertain {uncertain}, unlined {unlined} points.
fp_panel.more_rows: The largest and smallest {n} of {total} are listed.
fp_panel.old_footer: A comparison of places, not of years before and after: see the Impact assessment tab.
fp_panel.unit_summary_plain: Average over {n} assessed ponds (95% range {lo} to {hi} points of cropping intensity).
